statement: For every field F of characteristic two, with V = gl_2(F)/(F I) carrying the induced commutator bracket, there do not exist a vector-space isomorphism T: V -> F^3 and an invertible linear map E: F^3 -> F^3 such that T([x,y]) = E(T(x) cross T(y)) for every x,y in V. Equivalently, the assertion P(F) in problem.md is false for every characteristic-two field; the bracket map beta_F: Lambda^2 V -> V has rank exactly 2.
contribution: A complete field-uniform negative resolution by a basis-free equivalence and an exact invariant rank obstruction. The characteristic-two cross product induces an isomorphism Lambda^2 F^3 -> F^3, whereas the quotient commutator map has rank 2. No novelty or priority beyond the frozen source boundary is asserted.
